methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing for 8 leading grammar-checker vendors was collected by fetching each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-15. Where the live page rendered a non-USD currency or failed (403/JS-only), the figure was sourced from a reputable 2025/2026 comparison page (fixthephoto.com/best-grammar-checker.html, slashdot.org software profiles, getapp.com, sourceforge.net) and flagged in provenance. monthlyUsd records the effective monthly cost at the smallest self-serve unit: for annual plans this is the annualised monthly equivalent (annual total ÷ 12). Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless the vendor explicitly states otherwise on their public site.

USD starting price of $12/mo corroborated by sourceforge.net/software/product/Grammarly/ and slashdot.org/software/p/Grammarly/ (both 2026-06-15). Enterprise = contact sales confirmed on official page.

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: VERIFIED 2026-06-16: $12/mo is the annual-billing rate ($144/yr); month-to-month is $30/mo and quarterly ~$20/mo (confirmed by demandsage 2026 pricing guide; official page geo-served EUR). monthlyUsd reflects the lowest self-serve (annual) rate per methodology. Grammarly Pro is billed per member (adds members up to 149) — hence per_seat. Includes full sentence rewrites, tone adjustment, fluency suggestions, plagiarism detection, AI-generated text detection, 2,000 AI prompts/member/month. 7-day free trial.
